register_unary_ops: register unary PyTorch operators like add_ and clamp_ via UnaryOp wrappers
register_callable_ops: register callable PyTorch operators like add, bmm, matmul, mean, and reshape via CallableOp wrappers
register_buildable_ops: register buildable PyTorch nn modules like Conv2d, Linear, and Dropout via BuildableOp wrappers
review_unary_ops_dict: review the unary_ops dictionary that maps torch.add_ and torch.clamp_ to UnaryOp instances
summarize_operator_registrations: summarize the three operator registration groups: unary_ops, callable_ops, and buildable_ops
